name: figthread
description: Design, validate, browser-review, package, export, and resume semantic figure work from promoted evidence-bound authority.

interface.shortDescription: Author figures with browser-certified text evidence
interface.longDescription: A semantic figure authoring skill that turns claims into promoted semantic, grammar, visual, profile, layout, and rendering authority, certifies browser-resolved text bounds and platform fonts, compiles semantic motion, packages self-contained HTML, exports content-addressed derivatives, and supports resumable evidence-bound execution.
defaultPrompt: Use Figthread for this explanatory figure.
Turn this claim into a publication-ready semantic figure and certify its browser-resolved text bounds and platform fonts.
Resume and validate this figure from its Figthread run directory.
